observations: Photo 0 shows a black Xbox One console with a visible disc drive and a warning label on the front left side.
Photo 1 shows the same console with a black Xbox One controller placed on top.
The console has a textured surface with a greenish glow on the right side, possibly from a sticker or reflection.
The controller has the standard Xbox layout: D-pad, analog sticks, and colored face buttons (X, Y, A, B).
The console appears to be in a used condition with some dust and minor wear.
No games, cables, or accessories are visible in the photos.
The seller claims to have 6 games including FC, but none are shown.

identity.kind: Xbox One console with one controller

claims.claim: Xbox one with one pad for sell
claims.evidence: Photo 0 and photo 1 show the console and controller.
No games are visible in the photos. The claim cannot be verified from the images.
No power adapter is visible in the photos. The claim about an adaptor issue cannot be confirmed or denied from the images.

risks.proof: A video showing the controller connecting to the console and responding to button presses.

risks.risk: The games may be missing, damaged, or not included as claimed.
risks.proof: Photos of all six games with their cases and discs, or a video showing them being loaded and played.

risks.risk: The power adapter may be missing or damaged.
risks.proof: Photo of the power adapter and its label, showing it is compatible with the console.
